task.title: Fix structured JSONL parser handling of escaped newlines
task.prompt: Fix the log parser in /workspace/parser/jsonl.py so escaped newlines inside quoted message fields do not split records, and ensure pytest passes.

workspace_files.tests/test_jsonl.py:
from parser.jsonl import parse_stream
def test_escaped_newline():
    rows = parse_stream('{"msg":"line1\\nline2"}\n')
    assert rows == [{'msg': 'line1\nline2'}]

final_answer:
